items.text: Popularity word cloud — the tags tab cloud matches the dashboard / style: larger tags mean more bookmarks, tier colours, light enter/drift animations, and a slight rotation per tag. Click a chip to scroll to that tag in the list.
Structured tag list — column headers (Tag / Usage / Actions), a usage bar per row, and tags sorted by bookmark count so popular tags stand out at the top.
Natural scrolling — the tag list grows with your tags and scrolls with the config page instead of a fixed inner panel and scrollbar.
Page width — cloud and list stay within the same width as other config tabs (Pages, Collections); long tag names truncate with an ellipsis.
Smarter filter autocomplete — when you type a category or tag name in search, matching filter values appear before generic keyword hints (e.g. cat suggests real categories before the category: hint).
Top 20 tag suggestions — empty tag: lists the 20 most-used tags (by bookmark count); type any part of a tag name to find the rest.
Bare tag hints — typing a tag name without tag: uses the same usage-ranked suggestions as the filter command.

Modular config.js — tab tours, persistence, tab lifecycle, domain controllers (pages, categories, finders, themes), and setup/event wiring moved into dedicated static/js/config/ modules; config.js is now a thin orchestrator (~1 600 lines).
Dashboard reload flicker — config persistence signals structure sync without a full dashboard flash when settings change.
Config Playwright tests — coverage for tab tours, persistence, tab lifecycle, domain glue, setup wiring, keyboard tab, and tags tab UI (cloud, list, sort, filter, drill-down).

Playwright hardening — opt-in dev-server reuse with /api/pages health check, retries, single worker, and serial promo/overlay/command specs for stable CI; npm run test:e2e:reuse when a local server is already running.
Docs — README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG, config help, and whats-new updated for v2026.06.25.
